about: A fixed activity saved over a recurring one (docs/protocol/core.md CORE-3.9, api.md API-1.147): the question and pieces Camp Setup's Fixed activities table works out (lwc/shoreshProgram fixedOver.js, fixedOverExamples.test.js) and the AI's port works out (AgentFixedOver, FixedOverExamplesTest) must both be these. On SetTimeTestData's camp (below). Each example: the program's extra days and groups only there part of the day, the recurring activities saved first (each for everyone unless it covers groups; days are its ticked days), a fixed activity saved first (saved, length 1), then the save: a new fixed activity, or the saved one with only the fields given (save), with weeks ticked off or back on in it. asks is null for no question (they never meet, or one sits only in its blocks and can't go around it); else the heading, its line and each piece kept, in order (seen: the recurring activity as it was read).
